title: US $ 2.5 million cyber heist comes under IMF watch
byline: The theft of US $ 2.5 million by cybercriminals who breached the computer systems of the Finance Ministry has come under the spotlight of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), which is closely watching the situation, a spokesperson said.

title: Iran says ‘no meeting’ to take place with the US in Islamabad
byline: Esmaeil Baghaei, spokesman for Iran’s Foreign Ministry, says “no meeting is planned to take place between Iran and the US”.

title: Iran’s foreign minister arrives in Pakistan, Trump expects offer satisfying US demands
byline: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi arrived in the Pakistani capital Islamabad on Friday to discuss proposals ​for restarting peace talks with the U.S., offering some hope for an end to the eight-week war that has killed thousands and sown turmoil in global markets.

title: Australian officers currently assisting investigations in SL
byline: Australian officers are currently assisting with Sri Lanka’s investigation into the incident in which cyber criminals stole US $ 2.5 million after breaching the computer systems of the Finance Ministry, according to Australian High Commissioner Matthew Duckworth.

title: Severe lightning advisory issued for several areas
byline: The Department of Meteorology issued an advisory for severe lightning for the Western, Sabaragamuwa and North-Eestern Provinces and the Galle, Matara, Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts after 1.00 p.m today.

title: Fitch warns Asia faces higher food inflation risk
byline: Fitch Ratings has warned that emerging markets in Asia could face rising cost pressures across agribusiness and food supply chains if a prolonged US-Iran conflict disrupts global fertiliser supplies during the planting season.

title: Person who shot dead constable during Kasippu raid sentenced to death after 18 year trial
byline: One of the four accused who stood indicted with the murder of a constable during a raid on an illicit brewery was found guilty and sentenced to death by Balapitiya High Court Judge Ruchira Weliwatta.

title: Conduct independent forensic audit on hacking of US $ 2.5 million: FLSP
byline: Whilst raising concerns on the hacking of US $ 2.5 million, which was sent as an instalment payment for a loan which the government of Sri Lanka has borrowed, the Front Line Socialist Party (FLSP) yesterday called for an independent forensic audit by a reputed institution.

title: Pressure mounts on Finance Secretary to resign
byline: The association called ’Free Lawyers’, which exposed the US $ 2.5 million cyber theft, urged Finance Ministry Secretary Harshana Suriyapperuma to step down.

title: Surge in scams raises alarm over financial fraud and data theft in Sri Lanka
byline: Sri Lanka is witnessing a troubling surge in sophisticated scams, with fraudsters increasingly exploiting public trust, government identities, and digital platforms to steal personal and financial information.

title: Bangladesh duo sanctioned for ICC Code of Conduct breach during ICC Women’s Championship against Sri Lanka
byline: Nahida Akter and Sarmin Sultana of Bangladesh have been fined 10 per cent of their match fee for breaching the ICC Code of Conduct.

title: Government aims to significantly reduce deaths caused due to road accidents by 2029: Bimal
byline: Claiming that the government has undertaken significant work to ensure transport safety, Minister of Transport and Highways Bimal Rathnayake said today that the government is planning to significantly reduce the number of deaths caused due to road accidents by the year 2029.

title: Pirates hijack oil tanker off the coast of Somalia, Sri Lankan among crew
byline: Pirates have hijacked an oil tanker with 17 crew that was sailing near the Somali coast, according to multiple security officials who spoke to the BBC.

title: Sri Lankan arrested with Rs. 25 mn worth Kush at BIA
byline: A 33-year-old Sri Lankan, who was arriving from Bangkok, was arrested with 2,505 gms of Kush valued at Rs. 25 million at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA).

title: Trump says he canceled US negotiators’ trip to Pakistan for Iran talks
byline: U.S. ​President Donald ‌Trump canceled a ​planned ​trip to Pakistan ⁠by ​envoys Jared ​Kushner and Steve Witkoff ​for ​peace talks with ‌Iran, ⁠Fox News reported on ​Saturday.

title: Asanga Seneviratne elected President of National Olympic Committee
byline: Asanga Seneviratne, the President of the Sri Lanka Baseball Federation, has been elected as the new President of the National Olympic Committee of Sri Lanka.

title: Iran says it won’t accept ’maximalist demands’ as Islamabad hosts peace push
byline: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi laid out Iran’s demands and its reservations about U.S. positions on Saturday as Islamabad hosted a new push to end a war that has ​killed thousands and roiled global markets.
